"Love Brew" is an upcoming New age Telugu Romcom Web Series featuring Pravallika Damerla and Adarsh as Leads.

"Meera, a cheerful café employee with a strong sense of justice, and Abhi, a wealthy businessman searching for genuine love, come from two completely different worlds. After being drawn to Meera's kindness and fearless nature through a series of chance encounters, Abhi decides to hide his identity to get closer to her. But before he can make a move, Meera catches him following her, setting up an unexpected first confrontation."
